text:
Michael C: :rotating_light: Heads up — after last night's driver roll (nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1) we're seeing kernel failures for TensorRT/FlashAttention/xformers on A100 fleet in us-west-2.
Sara L: saw a few SRE alerts, any common error?
Michael C: sample log from a failed infer job:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA error: unspecified launch failure
  File "/opt/worker/infer.py", line 342, in forward
    outputs = flash_attn_cuda.forward(inputs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/flash_attn/_flash_attn.so", line 1, in <compiled code>
```
Oliver (oncall): Also seeing NCCL errors in multi-GPU runs in eu-central-1: "ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled system error"
Jia: quick triage — did the AMI bump cuda/cudnn library paths? ldconfig or symlink mismatch common.
Sara L: repro on canary (h100 pool) — xformers import segfaults immediately. Running `python -c "import xformers; print(xformers.__version__)"` crashes.
Michael C: repro script: `docker run --gpus all --rm my-image:cuda12.1 python -c "import torch; import xformers; print('ok')"` fails with sigsegv
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T02:10Z started: driver-update -> us-west-2-canary
Oliver (oncall): rollback suggestion — pin driver back to 525.85 on canary, confirm tests.
Sara L: I'm spinning canary rollback now on 3 hosts (a100s). ETA ~10m.
Jia: likely root cause: vendor kernels (Triton/flash-attn) prebuilt against libcuda symbols that changed in 535.x; also TensorRT builds tied to specific libcudart versions.
Michael C: short-term: rollback drivers & restore previous AMI. Medium-term: rebuild wheels in CI with CUDA12.1 driver ABI & add canary matrix covering 525/535.
Oliver (oncall): also need a network check — NCCL errors may be related to mlx5 driver/firmware mismatch after kernel upgrade. Can infra confirm Mellanox FW versions?
infra-bot: hw-inventory: us-west-2-a100: firmware mlx5 22.27.1020
Sara L: noted. I'll add a check to infra health dashboard to alert when driver/firmware combos are nonstandard.
Jia: test plan: 1) pin to 525 on canary 2) rebuild xformers/flash-attn wheels inside CUDA12.1 container & run unit + perf smoke 3) re-run multi-node NCCL test (torch.distributed.launch) 4) staged rollout.
Michael C: reminder — update the model-serving docs about ABI compatibility and a quick command: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,compute_cap --format=csv` and `ldd /usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/tensorrt/libnvinfer.so`
Oliver (oncall): if rollback succeeds, schedule full fleet rollout pause and create RFC for driver upgrade that includes rebuilds and firmware checks. @Sara L can you make the RFC draft?
Sara L: on it. Will circulate in #eng-runtime and tag platform eng for AMI bake changes.
Michael C: thanks — logging incident and will open a postmortem if rollout impacted >5% of requests.
